payload.name: Cognitive bottleneck in auditory augmentation
payload.fact: Humans cannot simultaneously comprehend multiple full conversations when cognitively augmented, as this exceeds functional cognitive limits.

provenance.title: Investigating the Boundary of Auditory Augmentation:Interface Design for Chimeric Service Actor in Multi-Conversation Scenarios
provenance.quote_or_locus: Specifically, it demonstrates that cognitively augmenting humans into “superhumans” capable of simultaneously comprehending multiple full conversations is impossible due to cognitive bottlenecks
